title: Keep a practical first CI job reduction

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Caught.

Checked the developer-amended SEED-350#run-ci-on-fewer-jobs promise in .planning/seeds/SEED-350-fewer-ci-jobs.md: eight concurrent group probes retain eight separate real HTML reports. Implementation revision: e4a24ce97ac855b5c81b0dfbe174aefcd0022c68. This result supports that observed behavior only; it makes no minimum-job, no-slower-overlap, or failed-child-cleanup claim.

The only fault removed runStamp from the HTML outputFolder in dashboard/tests/support/runnerConfig.mjs:155, changing path.join(outputs, runOutputs.report, runStamp) to path.join(outputs, runOutputs.report). Fixtures and assertions stayed intact. The maintained case was dashboard/backend-tests/runtime/runner-ownership.spec.ts:119, “group runs started beside each other keep their own run directories and records”, using groupRunnerExamples from dashboard/tests/support/groupRunnerExamples.ts. It launches eight real CLI children: two each for integrated, frontend, backend, and E2E.

All three proof stages used the same focused command, with stage-specific external proof-record paths:
CI=1 OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_PROOF_RECORD=<stage-proof.json> node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --config dashboard/backend.playwright.config.ts dashboard/backend-tests/runtime/runner-ownership.spec.ts --grep 'group runs started beside each other keep their own run directories and records' --workers=1
The command ran under caffeinate -s -i with /opt/homebrew/bin first in PATH, preserving the eight-child concurrency and normal timeouts.

Baseline: selectedCount 1; runnerStatus and strictStatus passed; exit 0. The filesystem inventory contained eight distinct stamped child HTML index files, plus the outer runner's stamped report.

Fault: selectedCount 1; runnerStatus and strictStatus failed; exit 1. All eight child results, selected proof records, expected output parents, and eight unique output directories had passed their maintained checks before the failure. The assertion that caught the fault was expect(existsSync(report), report).toBe(true) at runner-ownership.spec.ts:182. It named the absent dashboard/tests/playwright-report/2026-11-14T11-48-33.312Z-77801/index.html. Independent filesystem inspection after the settled run found the four groups' shared static playwright-report/index.html files and no stamped child report indexes. This establishes wrong behavior on the exercised path, beyond merely executing the changed configuration.

Restored: original source bytes were restored; selectedCount 1; runnerStatus and strictStatus passed; exit 0. Eight distinct stamped child indexes and the outer stamped index existed again. Scratch Git status matched the initially clean state and git diff --exit-code passed. The test awaited Promise.allSettled for all eight children; after the final run no live process command referenced the scratch checkout. The detached scratch /tmp/seed350-intent.8dSiMd/checkout was retired with git worktree remove. No branch, active checkout, commit, push, CI dispatch, full suite, or local benchmark was changed or run. Logs, proof records, fault diff and HTML inventories remain outside the retired worktree in /tmp/seed350-intent.8dSiMd/.

Next proof action: retain the existing behavioral HTML assertion with the adopted fix; this probe calls for no additional test. No configuration-count assertion or new follow-up is proposed.

Prior disposition: this catches the static-folder regression already addressed by the accepted per-run HTML-directory fix reused from main. It confirms that disposition; it does not make a new repair decision or expand either developer-selected follow-up. Failure policy followed: AGENTS.md#failing-and-flaky-tests. The only test failure after establishing the baseline was the intentional scratch fault.

Setup and scope notes: AC power was confirmed; starting load was 2.37 on 16 logical CPUs with about 5.4 GiB free memory; ending load was 4.97. The scratch had its own locked npm ci --ignore-scripts installation (2 s), and Playwright 1.65.0 worked there. No mutable dependency installation was copied or symlinked. Test-entry selection resolved this backend source to makeMe: true, pageObjects: false; no test was edited. An initial anchored grep selected zero tests because Playwright matches the full title. A preliminary corrected passing run encountered an already-existing external proof-record filename, so it was followed by a clean passing baseline with a fresh record before applying the fault.

- Test runtime: measured from the retained runner terminal.durationMs: baseline 10.612 s, fault 8.346 s, restored 8.576 s; total 27.533 s. The associated case durations were 9.799 s, 7.802 s and 7.896 s. Additional setup attempts cost 3.745 s of runner time for zero selected tests and 8.63 s measured command wall time for the preliminary passing run whose proof record was stale.
- Human effort: estimated 0 min of incremental human intervention during this probe; none was requested or observed. The preceding task-authoring effort is outside this estimate.
- Agent effort: unavailable as a separate active-time or token measure; this run exposed no independent agent-effort counter. Invocation elapsed below is not substituted for it.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 293411 ms (measured), from 1794656739000 to 1794657032411 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.


Wrap-up disposition

Checked implementation: e4a24ce97ac855b5c81b0dfbe174aefcd0022c68. Retain the meaningful concurrent HTML-report behavior assertion; no additional test is requested. The three new configuration-string assertions were removed separately. Broader configuration/data-only cleanup is SEED-354, queued first; redesigned further CI reduction is SEED-355, queued second, by explicit developer direction. The bounded adoption claims neither a minimum nor no-slower overlap.
